docker-compose.description: deploy/compose.yaml is an example for readers, not a deployed stack, so it keeps the floating `latest` tag and Renovate leaves it alone (a deployment pins its own digest). Scoped under the docker-compose manager rather than set at top level: a top-level ignorePaths REPLACES the list inherited from :ignoreModulesAndTests instead of merging with it

packageRules.description: Alpine apk pins are extracted by Renovate's built-in dockerfile manager (>= 44.96.0) as datasource `apk`; the :alpine preset supplies the grouping, rangeStrategy and automerge posture but stays release-line agnostic, so this URL is the ONE place the Alpine release line is written. Bump `branch=v3.24` when the base image crosses a release line (3.24 -> 3.25). `components=main,community` merges both indexes in a single lookup (registryStrategy 'merge'), so community packages need no separate registryUrls override.

zebrash comes from github.com/Gobbo89/zebrash, a fork kept up by one person after github.com/ingridhq/zebrash stopped being maintained; it still pulls github.com/ingridhq/gg and github.com/ingridhq/maxicode from the same abandoned org. All three run in-process on untrusted uploads next to label data with names and addresses, so every update gets a human read of its diff before it merges: no automerge and a `needs-review` label. Their own groupName takes them out of :automerge's `all non-major dependencies` bundle, so holding these back doesn't hold back the rest. This rule doesn't cover vulnerability-fix PRs: the fleet's vulnerabilityAlerts config (automerge: true) is applied with `force`, which beats packageRules.

gozxing decodes the label images in-process for the barcode check: untrusted input next to label data with names and addresses. It's barely maintained (one tag, v0.1.1 in 2021; master last changed in 2025-07) and pinned to a master pseudo-version, since the tag lacks the *image.Gray fast path and the PR #75 race fix, so updates arrive as digest PRs rather than releases and each needs a human read of its diff: no automerge and a `needs-review` label. Its own groupName takes it out of :automerge's `all non-major dependencies` bundle. Vulnerability-fix PRs still automerge (the fleet's vulnerabilityAlerts is applied with `force`).
